payload.title: QA notebook-write spec lacks 200L self-cap — recurring breach (re-prune treadmill)
payload.root_cause: QA agent appends a cycle entry to docs/agent-memory/notebooks/qa.md every cycle with no self-cap. Prior maintenance task MAINT-QA-NOTEBOOK-PRUNE-200L pruned 207L→195L (commit fe93258b); the very next QA cycle (commit a7befb0c, +8L) re-breached to 203L. This is STRUCTURAL unbounded-append, not a one-off.
payload.why_not_reprune: Per router-S1 recurrence flag in docs/agent-memory/decisions/sprint-MAINT-on-demand-router.md: a re-breach after the next QA cycle must NOT be re-pruned (treadmill). The standing context_bloat_breach signal (to=claude-manager-helper) only triggers another prune.
payload.requested_fix: Route to agent-father: add self-cap / auto-trim logic to the QA agent's notebook-write step (drop oldest cycle(s) when append would exceed 200L), so the cap is enforced at write-time by the writer, not by an external janitor prune. Per feedback_agent_md_factory: invoke agent-md-factory skill first; agent .md changes are agent-father territory.
payload.evidence: wc -l docs/agent-memory/notebooks/qa.md = 203 (cap 200); router-S1 DJ recurrence flag; commits fe93258b (prune) then a7befb0c (re-breach)
